name: Faisal Basri
detail: Prominent senior economist at FEB Universitas Indonesia and founder of INDEF; died 5 September 2024.

name: Budi Frensidy
detail: Guru Besar FEB UI; authored op-ed in Kompas (10 May 2026) titled "Pajak Kekayaan, Jalan Pintas yang Menyesatkan" arguing against net wealth taxation.

name: Yon Arsal
detail: Staf Ahli Kemenkeu Bidang Kepatuhan Pajak; acknowledged international discussion on wealth taxes at FPBI launch but emphasized long regulatory hurdles and cost-benefit analysis without endorsing policy.

name: Said Iqbal
detail: President of KSPI and Partai Buruh; campaigned for "fair wealth redistribution" through social security and opposed double taxes on worker pensions (JHT), but has not endorsed a net wealth tax.

name: Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa
detail: Minister of Finance from September 2025; emphasized tax extensification and cautioned against "killing the golden goose", focusing on enforcing compliance in existing sectors rather than enacting wealth taxes.
